formationTraining.authoredEffect: Improve the conversion of local Warrior population into Martial Support, especially for Campaign/Defense.
formationTraining.authoredHook: Future Warrior candidates from this settlement can gain small Prowess development.

charge.triggerText: When a local Warrior Practice consumes [Arms] or contributes Martial Support to a Campaign/Defense.
charge.dischargeText: Bank +2 Formation Support for the next Campaign or Defense supported from this settlement.

provisionalNotes: Banks +2 local Support for the next real Campaign or Defense. Candidate training hooks remain provisional.

veteranInstruction.label: Veteran Instruction

ui.rule: When a Warrior Vassal survives a Dangerous Martial action. Gain 1 base Charge. At 2 Charge, Discharge: Require at least 1 Warrior here. Bank 1 Prowess Development for the next Warrior candidate.

veteranInstruction.authoredEffect: Improve future Warrior candidate development/Prowess progress based on local Warrior population.

charge.triggerText: When a Warrior Vassal survives a Dangerous Martial action.
charge.dischargeText: Require at least 1 Warrior here. Bank 1 Prowess Development for the next Warrior candidate.

provisionalNotes: Banked Prowess Development gives the next generated Warrior candidate +1 Prowess; no choice conversion UI.

siegeTraining.label: Siege Training

ui.rule: When Campaign Support is calculated; Require Stocked [Construction] + stocked [Arms]; Increase civilization Support specifically for Conquest/Retake Campaigns.

siegeTraining.authoredEffect: Increase civilization Support specifically for Conquest/Retake Campaigns.
siegeTraining.authoredHook: Lets settled/engineering Warrior builds differ from mobile raiders.
provisionalNotes: Supplied Support multiplier is +25%; Birth banks +1 Support. Specialized Conquest/Retake weighting is deferred.

caravanGuarding.label: Caravan Guarding

ui.rule: When an external Trade effect resolves through this settlement. Gain 1 base Charge. At 2 Charge, Discharge: Require positive local Martial Support. Generate 2 Stock.

caravanGuarding.authoredEffect: Banks value from repeated external Trade; on Discharge it generates local Currency/Mobility Stock while supplied.
caravanGuarding.authoredHook: Allows Warrior population to support peaceful exchange as well as raiding.

charge.triggerText: When an external Trade effect resolves through this settlement.
charge.dischargeText: Require positive local Martial Support. Generate 2 Stock.

provisionalNotes: Secondary hook uses current numeric training/candidate/preview/support grammar; authored choice, Legacy and specialized action variants remain deferred.

rescueParties.label: Rescue Parties

ui.rule: At a shortage or Monster Crisis: Consume 1 [Edible]. Require [Mobility] or [Power]. Rescue up to 5 people into available Housing in a connected friendly settlement.

rescueParties.authoredEffect: Adds a non-conquest option to eligible Crisis incidents: move endangered population/Stock before deterministic loss.
rescueParties.authoredHook: Warrior Vassal may personally join, adding Prowess/Retinue if the response is Dangerous.
provisionalNotes: Real Crisis evacuation moves up to 5 people, preserving specialists, to a connected friendly site with Housing. Stock rescue and personal martial joining are deferred.

forcedMarches.label: Forced Marches

ui.rule: Campaign / Travel support; Consume 1 [Edible]; Require 1 stocked [Mobility] or [Power] Practice; Extend how far local Martial Support can contribute to a Campaign or reduce movement time at extra supply cost.

forcedMarches.authoredEffect: Extend how far local Martial Support can contribute to a Campaign or reduce movement time at extra supply cost.
forcedMarches.authoredHook: Prowess still supplies personal Force; this extends civilization contribution.
provisionalNotes: Birth banks +1 local Support. Extra travel/support distance and reduced travel time are deferred.

warbandMarching.label: Warband Marching

ui.rule: When Martial Support is projected; Consume 1 [Edible]; Require 1 stocked [Mobility] Practice; Allow a capped share of Warrior population from an adjacent friendly settlement to contribute Martial Support.

warbandMarching.authoredEffect: Allow a capped share of Warrior population from an adjacent friendly settlement to contribute Martial Support.
provisionalNotes: Birth banks coordination for one connected friendly source at 25%, capped at 10 Support.

feastingTheHost.label: Feasting the Host

ui.rule: When this settlement gains Stock with [Loot] or [Currency]. Gain 1 base Charge. At 3 Charge, Discharge: Require Warrior population here. Progress Warrior population and class-candidate weighting.

feastingTheHost.authoredEffect: Increase Warrior-population growth/candidate weighting and local Happiness/Faith effect numerically.
feastingTheHost.authoredHook: Turns successful raiding into social reproduction rather than only money.

charge.triggerText: When this settlement gains Stock with [Loot] or [Currency].
charge.dischargeText: Require Warrior population here. Progress Warrior population and class-candidate weighting.

provisionalNotes: Trains one adult Warrior and banks +1 next-candidate Prowess; Happiness/Faith and class-weighted sampling are deferred.

tournaments.label: Tournaments

ui.rule: When a Warrior Vassal completes a Challenge, or a Warrior candidate gains Prowess Development. Gain 1 base Charge. At 3 Charge, Discharge: Require Warrior population here. Bank 1 Prowess Development for the next Warrior candidate.

tournaments.authoredEffect: Increase future Warrior candidate Prowess-development progress and class weighting.
tournaments.authoredHook: Challenge-oriented Vassals may gain improved local Challenge options.

charge.triggerText: When a Warrior Vassal completes a Challenge, or a Warrior candidate gains Prowess Development.
charge.dischargeText: Require Warrior population here. Bank 1 Prowess Development for the next Warrior candidate.

provisionalNotes: Banks +1 next-candidate Prowess. Specialized Challenge options and candidate class weights are deferred.

warCouncil.label: War Council

ui.rule: When this or a connected settlement contributes Martial Support to a Campaign or Defense. Gain 1 base Charge. At 3 Charge, Discharge: Bank Coordination: the next Campaign/Defense may draw Support from one additional adjacent friendly settlement.

warCouncil.authoredEffect: Increase the share of neighboring Martial Support that can be coordinated into one conflict.
warCouncil.authoredHook: Future Warrior candidates gain better Campaign target information.

charge.triggerText: When this or a connected settlement contributes Martial Support to a Campaign or Defense.
charge.dischargeText: Bank Coordination: the next Campaign/Defense may draw Support from one additional adjacent friendly settlement.

provisionalNotes: Banks one extra connected friendly Support source at 25%, capped at 10 Support. New Campaign information UI is deferred.

greatHost.label: Great Host

ui.rule: When an external Martial action resolves using Support from 2 or more settlements. Gain 1 base Charge. At 3 Charge, Discharge: Require a large Warrior population and connected support network. Bank Great Host: the next Campaign/Defense may combine a capped share of Support from all connected friendly settlements.

greatHost.authoredEffect: Major build-around: combine a capped share of Martial Support from multiple connected settlements into one external action.
greatHost.authoredHook: Creates late-game conqueror/defender scale without changing the basic Force grammar.

charge.triggerText: When an external Martial action resolves using Support from 2 or more settlements.
charge.dischargeText: Require a large Warrior population and connected support network. Bank Great Host: the next Campaign/Defense may combine a capped share of Support from all connected friendly settlements.

provisionalNotes: Requires 20 Warriors and a connected Warrior settlement. Banks contributions from connected friendly settlements at 50%, capped at 10 each.
